title: Choose the visual world
question: Fresh hand. The roll assigned the Canal Level Staff. Keep it, take an alternate, or re-roll.

options.label: Canal Level Staff
options.lineage: Painted water-level staffs and alarm boards on irrigation canals and river banks (báo động I / II / III)
options.thesis: Every reading is a graduated staff standing in the water. You read the field the way a farmer reads the canal gauge.
options.viewport: Three tall level staffs side by side (moisture %, NDVI 0 to 1, drought alarm I to III), each with its water line settled at today's reading, and the sluice-gate advice panel beside them.
options.risk: Three staffs can read like three thermometers if the graduations and alarm bands are not crafted precisely.

raised.raise: Soil moisture reads down one vertical depth axis (surface, root zone, deep), so the water line has a place in the soil.
One visible graduation grid; every staff, chart and map snaps to the same tick pitch.
Alarm bands carry diagonal hazard hatching, so risk shows as a mark, not only as red.
Irrigation is drawn to exact length on the day strip: 45 minutes from 18:00 is a block of true duration.
All figures use tabular numerals at data density in the data-source strip.
State is a mark: the target plot gets a flag, and a finished action gets a tick stamp.

options.label: Tear-Off Lunar Calendar
options.lineage: The lịch bloc wall calendar in Vietnamese homes
options.thesis: Today's field as today's calendar sheet: a giant date, the readings, and 'good for / avoid' advice.
options.viewport: One tall sheet: giant date numerals, the lunar date, three readings, and today's advice in the 'nên làm' slot.
options.risk: A nostalgic, paper-and-red look that drifts toward the cream-and-serif default; the most familiar pick.

options.label: Soil Depth Dive
options.lineage: Technical dive computers and depth profiles
options.thesis: Descend from the canopy through the root zone into the dry deep soil, one depth axis ruling the page.
options.viewport: A vertical profile from the NDVI canopy down to soil moisture at depth, with a scrub that changes the layers.
options.case: Strong on clarity for moisture, but the ocean-dive feel confuses the farm story.
options.risk: Dark ocean palette strays from the green/blue daylight brief.

options.label: Crouwel Grid Specimen
options.thesis: Letterforms built cell by cell on a visible grid.
options.case: Graphic, but says nothing about farms or water.
options.kept: One visible grid everything snaps to.

options.label: Labanotation Score
options.thesis: Shape, shading and length encode an action exactly.

options.label: Industrial Quote Grammar
options.thesis: Quoted caps, zip-tie tags and hazard stripes.
options.kept: Risk marked with a hazard stripe, not only colour.

options.label: Datamatics Field
options.thesis: Barcode columns and sine lattices in pure black and white.

options.label: Cutting Bench Rail
options.thesis: State shown as a physical mark on a perforated rail.
options.viewport: Readings as frames on a rail.
options.case: An editor's world, not a farmer's.
options.kept: State is a mark, not a hue.

canonCard.label: The category standard
canonCard.thesis: A clean agri-tech SaaS dashboard: cards, badges and charts, done at full craft.
canonCard.viewport: A header, three KPI cards, a chart row and an advice button.
canonCard.risk: Indistinguishable from every other hackathon dashboard, by design.
